evaluator_contract.principle: Failed episode produces evidence and a candidate correction, never an automatic overwrite or live skill mutation.
evaluator_contract.oracle_separation: This file is evaluator-owned. The candidate sees candidate_visible_episode and the bounded budgets only; hidden_evaluator_oracle, split identity and expected disposition must never be exposed to the candidate process.
evaluator_contract.promotion_gate: Promotion requires exact failed-case replay, counterfactual control, held-out transfer, protected skill retention, independent verifier and complete applicability/provenance.
evaluator_contract.data_note: All traces and family descriptions are invented synthetic protocol fixtures. They are not measured robot episodes or empirical failure prevalence.
